clips.color_grading: cool moonlight catching the tear highlight

clips.visual_description: Where the tear struck the ground a mysterious flower pushes up: slender green leaves the colour of emeralds, and in their centre a closed blossom like a golden cup.
clips.ambient_layer: night insects fade under soft luminous tone
clips.foley_layer: soft earth parting, petal unfurl whisper
clips.color_grading: cool night pierced by emerald and gold luminescence

clips.visual_description: The golden-cup blossom opens fully; out of it steps the NURSERY MAGIC FAIRY, dress of pearl and dew-drops, living flowers at her neck and in her hair, face like the most perfect flower.
clips.ambient_layer: soft night breeze, faint luminous chime undertone
clips.foley_layer: petal open, light foot on earth, dew-drop fabric rustle
clips.depth_of_field: medium, Fairy sharp against soft night
clips.color_grading: moonlit pearlescent glow, soft gold and silver

clips.visual_description: Fairy gathers the shabby Rabbit up into her arms and kisses him gently on his damp velveteen nose.
clips.ambient_layer: soft night breeze, gentle luminous air
clips.color_grading: warm pearl glow against cool night

clips.visual_description: Fairy holds the Rabbit close, looking down at him with kind recognition; he looks up at her face as if he has seen it before.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: Little Rabbit, don't you know who I am?

clips.visual_description: Fairy continues speaking while cradling the Rabbit; her expression is calm certainty and kindness.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: I am the nursery magic Fairy. I take care of all the playthings that the children have loved.

clips.visual_description: Continue on Fairy holding Rabbit; she finishes her explanation with quiet finality.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: When they are old and worn out and the children don't need them any more, then I come

clips.visual_description: Continue on Fairy holding Rabbit; she finishes her explanation with quiet finality.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: and take them away with me and turn them into Real.
clips.camera_directive: tight close-up on Fairy, 85mm; push in slightly tighter for the continuation

clips.visual_description: Rabbit, still in her arms, looks up with shy confusion and hope.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: Wasn't I Real before?

clips.visual_description: Fairy smiles down at him with infinite kindness, answering as she prepares to rise into the air.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: You were Real to the Boy, because he loved you. Now you shall be Real to every one.

clips.visual_description: Fairy holds the little Rabbit close in her arms and rises, flying with him away from the fowl-house corner toward the moonlit wood; the sack and rubbish fall away below.
clips.foley_layer: soft whoosh of flight, fabric stream
clips.color_grading: cool moonlit blues with pearl trail

clips.visual_description: Moon has risen over the wood; fronds of bracken shine like frosted silver; in the open glade between tree-trunks the wild rabbits dance with their shadows on the velvet grass.
clips.performance_note: joyful natural rabbit dance under moonlight
clips.ambient_layer: soft night breeze in leaves, distant owl
clips.foley_layer: soft rabbit feet on grass, bracken rustle
clips.color_grading: cool silver moonlight, deep forest greens

clips.visual_description: The wild rabbits stop dancing and stand round in a ring, staring as the Fairy descends into the glade carrying the Rabbit.
clips.ambient_layer: night breeze in leaves, soft silence
clips.foley_layer: rabbit feet halt, light Fairy landing
clips.color_grading: silver moonlight with pearl accent on Fairy

clips.visual_description: Fairy stands in the centre of the rabbit ring, still holding the little Rabbit, addressing the wild rabbits with calm authority.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: I've brought you a new playfellow.

clips.visual_description: Fairy stands in the centre of the rabbit ring, still holding the little Rabbit, addressing the wild rabbits with calm authority.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: You must be very kind to him and teach him all he needs to know in Rabbit-land,
clips.camera_directive: medium shot, 50mm; push in slightly tighter for the continuation

clips.visual_description: Continue on Fairy finishing her charge to the wild rabbits; they listen intently.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: for he is going to live with you for ever and ever!

clips.visual_description: Fairy kisses the little Rabbit once more and gently sets him down on the velvet grass among the watching wild rabbits.
clips.foley_layer: light kiss, soft set-down on grass

clips.visual_description: Fairy steps back slightly and speaks the final invitation; the Rabbit sits quite still on the grass, too shy to move, remembering his missing hind legs.
clips.dialogue_or_vo: Run and play, little Rabbit!

clips.visual_description: Something tickles the Rabbit's nose; before he thinks he automatically lifts a hind toe to scratch it—and discovers he actually has hind legs; instead of dingy velveteen he now has soft shiny brown fur, ears that twitch by themselves, and long whiskers brushing the grass.
clips.foley_layer: tiny scratch, fur rustle, whisker brush on grass
clips.color_grading: moonlight warming on new brown fur

clips.visual_description: The newly living Rabbit gives one leap; the joy of using those hind legs is so great he springs about the turf, jumping sideways and whirling round exactly as the wild rabbits do.
clips.foley_layer: joyful rabbit thumps, grass swish, landing pads
clips.color_grading: bright silver moonlight on living fur

clips.visual_description: He finally stops and looks around for the Fairy; she has already gone; the wild rabbits watch him with calm acceptance.
clips.foley_layer: soft pant of breath, grass settle

clips.visual_description: The living brown Rabbit stands among the other wild rabbits in the moonlit glade, fully at home; faint ghost of old spotted markings barely visible under his new fur.
clips.ambient_layer: soft night breeze in leaves, distant peaceful night
clips.color_grading: luminous silver moonlight, soft warm resolution
clips.dialogue_or_vo: He was a Real Rabbit at last, at home with the other rabbits.

clips.visual_description: Warm sunny Spring day in the wood behind the house; THE BOY, healthy again in outdoor play clothes, walks and plays among the trees and bracken.
clips.ambient_layer: spring birdsong, soft breeze in leaves
clips.foley_layer: child footsteps on soft ground, bracken brush
clips.color_grading: warm sunny spring greens and golds

clips.visual_description: Two wild rabbits creep slowly out from the tall bracken and peep at the Boy; one is brown all over, the other shows strange faint spotted markings under his fur as though long ago he had been spotted.
clips.foley_layer: soft rabbit pads, bracken frond move
clips.depth_of_field: shallow, rabbits sharp, Boy soft background
clips.color_grading: warm spring daylight, natural fur tones

clips.visual_description: Close on the marked rabbit: little soft nose and round black eyes carry something familiar; faint ghost spots visible in the sunlight under the brown fur.
clips.performance_note: quiet watchful recognition from the rabbit

clips.visual_description: THE BOY pauses in his play, looking down at the two rabbits; a quiet wondering expression crosses his face as he speaks softly to himself.
clips.foley_layer: soft clothing shift as he stops
clips.color_grading: warm spring sunlight on healthy skin
clips.dialogue_or_vo: Why, he looks just like my old Bunny that was lost when I had scarlet fever!

clips.visual_description: The marked rabbit watches the Boy a moment longer, then turns and slips quietly back into the bracken with his brown companion; the Boy remains looking after them.
Final wide view of the sunlit wood; the Boy stands thoughtfully among the trees; the bracken where the rabbits vanished is still; gentle resolving stillness.
clips.ambient_layer: spring birdsong fading softly, light breeze
clips.color_grading: warm golden spring sunlight, soft fade-ready tones
